title: Rose
body:
"Mmm, smells sweet."

Description

The Rose is a purchasable item from The Oak Depot for 800$, and was added as a limited-time item as part of Version 1.3.0 (The Valentine's Day update).

V 1.54.0


The Rose are sellable common flowers, that can be found in the Flowering Meadows regions. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 100$ per Rose. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by 4% per flower.
